cells.gaps: The commission the law creates had not been installed by August 2026. The Supreme Court's ordinance of 16 April 2026 declared a request inadmissible for want of a referral to that commission and is not counted as the law applied.
cells.note: The implementing decree no. 2025-1837 and the October 2025 decree on the commission are rules made under the law, so stage 4. The Supreme Court's ruling turned on the missing commission, so question 4 is held at no and reported to Bill.
